title: runningImage()'s doc comment sits above lastStop() and is orphaned
description:
Two consecutive doc comments precede lastStop() in factory-sandbox.ts; the closer one wins, so runningImage() — the method umq [A2] names as the deploy-did-not-move-it proof — carries no doc, and a reader of lastStop() first sees an image doc that does not describe it. Move the five-line comment down to runningImage().
evidence: cloudflare/src/factory-sandbox.ts:688-704 (the runningImage doc block immediately above lastStop's own)
